subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally stop loading existing project `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` files above 1 MiB, or should this PR limit only explicitly selected prompt-input files until a compatible project-context policy is defined?
rationale: The bounded descriptor implementation is mechanically sound, but choosing to discard established project context is a persistent user-facing compatibility policy rather than a purely technical repair.

options.title: Limit explicit prompt files only
options.body: Retain the 10 MiB descriptor-bound cap for user-selected system prompt files and remove the 1 MiB project-context rejection until a compatible context policy is designed.

options.title: Approve bounded project context
options.body: Accept the 1 MiB context cap as an intentional upgrade behavior and require clear recovery guidance plus real startup proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Limit explicit prompt files only
recommendation.body: Retain the 10 MiB descriptor-bound cap for user-selected system prompt files and remove the 1 MiB project-context rejection until a compatible context policy is designed.
